description: This file defines functions for creating and registering new events within a CMake-based build or scripting environment. It includes two implementations of an 'event_new' function, one using curry functions and another using explicit function definitions, to facilitate event creation, handling, and global registration.

methods.name: event_new
methods.description: Creates a new event object with a unique or specified event ID, sets up associated handler functions, and registers the event globally.
